verdict.rationale: Solid documents the performance mechanisms behind this story: fine-grained reactivity that reruns only dependent code, no virtual DOM, built-in Context/Stores, tree-shaking and TypeScript support. One user reports success on a largish product for over a year, but another hands-on report says devtools are alpha, docs are lacking and the framework suits small experienced teams, and others note silent reactivity loss from destructuring with no lint and ecosystem gaps. Missing for 10: first-party guidance or tooling for large-team maintainability (linting for reactivity pitfalls, mature devtools), and independent evidence of large multi-team codebases staying maintainable.
